name: odd-one-out
description: Tools that find deviations from the convention a project already follows: N times this way, once differently. Instead of thresholds from nowhere, they compare code to the rest of the same repository.

plugins.name: odd-one-out
plugins.description: Finds places that deviate from the convention of the project itself: N times this way, once differently. Java, pom.xml, SQL migrations, JavaScript/TypeScript.
